steps.instruction: Read the request and declared route, changes, quality evidence, current remote observation and approval. Bind one exact boundary, verified commit, target ref and optional annotated tag. Confirm the approval covers every intended publication effect.

calls.purpose: Read publication authority and producer evidence.
Read local and remote heads and ancestry.

produces: Authorized publication boundary and observed remote head.

steps.instruction: Verify route, exact changed-file ownership, clean tree outside the boundary, branch policy and required original session receipts at the verified head. Run installed hooks without bypass.

reads.when: when required by the delivery chain

calls.purpose: Inspect tree, branches, diffs and hook configuration.

steps.instruction: Resolve only rule-covered merge hunks inside the owned boundary, rerun named gates on a merged head, then create the approved ref or push a non-force fast-forward. Create the optional annotated tag only when explicitly authorized. Never rebase, force or bypass a hook.

writes.when: only when the approved policy merge changes the local target branch
when a publication command is attempted

calls.purpose: Merge by policy and publish without force.
Rerun declared gates if a merge hunk was resolved.
Record the exact attempted effect and observed precondition.

steps.instruction: Fetch and read the remote ref and optional tag after the attempt. If completion was uncertain, this observation happens before any retry; a changed remote is never pushed blindly.

calls.purpose: Fetch and read back exact remote objects.

steps.instruction: Compare authority, boundary, hooks, merge provenance, verified commit and remote read-back. Record concrete defects; do not treat a rejected or uncertain push as published.

calls.purpose: Persist the publication receipt only from observed evidence.

produces: Concrete failed-criterion feedback or passing review results.

steps.instruction: Write and validate the response with actual commit and receipt outputs, observations and review results. Present a publication link only after remote read-back equals the verified commit.
